chunks: Jamil narrated from Zurarah, from Abu Ja'far and Abu Abdullah, peace be upon them:

Regarding a man who emancipated a slave who had wealth: to whom does the slave's wealth belong? He said: "If he knew that he had wealth, then his wealth followed him; otherwise, it belongs to the emancipator."

And regarding a man who sold a slave who had wealth, he said: "If his master who sold him knew that he had wealth, then the wealth belongs to the buyer; and if the seller did not know, then the wealth belongs to the seller."

key_terms.الْمُشْتَرِي: the buyer in the sale transaction
key_terms.الْمُعْتِقِ: the one who emancipated the slave
key_terms.مَالٌ: property or wealth owned by the slave

ai.seo_question: When a slave is emancipated or sold while possessing wealth, who legally owns that wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith gives legal rulings concerning the wealth of a slave in cases of emancipation and sale. The ruling depends on whether the owner or seller knew that the slave possessed wealth, determining whether that wealth follows the slave or remains with the other party.
